as_told.title: Recovery of missing Toughbooks and hard drives from a glacier lake

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he helped retrieve a UFO, says his team tracked down a person acting as their source, who led them high into the Sierra Nevada mountains of California to a glacier lake where hard drives were sealed in a steel container about 25 feet underwater. He tells it as an operation he took part in; in a later retelling he says the drives came from Toughbooks, rugged military laptops, and credits a man named Don Paul Bales. It is told as evidence that records tied to the secret retrievals were deliberately hidden.
